function invisibleButtonPressed () {
  if (!(finished == true)) jump 21 bytes
  this._parent._visible = false

function autoplay () {
  if (!!((getTimer() - waitStart) < waitTime)) jump 52 bytes
  clearInterval(autoplayInterval)
  if (!(finished == true)) jump 15 bytes
  this._visible = false
  jump 1 bytes
  play()
}
function startAutoplay () {
  waitStart = getTimer()
  autoplayInterval = setInterval(this, "autoplay", 40)
}
